name: Peoples Natural Gas
notes: Researched from public peoples-gas.com pages only. Peoples e-Account takes bank or card payments; one-time payments need only the account number (no e-Account registration). ACI Speedpay handles phone (1-866-338-5491, 24/7) and non-account card/e-check payments. Fees and payment limits are not published (fees left out). AutoPay is called Direct Debit: bank only, drafted on a day the customer picks 11 to 21 days after the bill date (format has one daysAfterBill; left to family default). Enroll under Payment > Payment Method > Bank Accounts > Add Bank Account > Direct Debit; cancel steps not published (online cancel inferred). Future-dated payments up to 30 days ahead, bank only (card scheduling not expressible). Pending payments under Billing > History. e-billing available after registering (enrollment steps not published). Stop service online through e-Account or 1-800-764-0111 (SSN needed); notice period not stated. Payment arrangements online not described (family default kept); CAP applications by phone or online. Text "Hello" to 1-800-764-0111 for text payments (not expressible).

autopay_cancel.note: Manage Direct Debit from the Payment Method page in Peoples e-Account.

scheduled_payment.note: Bank account payments can be scheduled up to 30 days ahead using the calendar in the Payment Schedule section.

cancel_service.note: Have your service address with ZIP code, preferred stop date and Social Security number ready, or call 1-800-764-0111.

help.title: Ways to pay
paragraphs: In Peoples e-Account choose Pay Bill, then Pay Now, to pay by bank account or card; a one-time payment needs only your account number. You can also choose Make a Payment Now to pay through ACI Speedpay by card or electronic check without enrolling; allow 2 days to post.

Pay by phone through Speedpay at 1-866-338-5491, 24 hours a day; payments before 4 p.m. Eastern on business days post the same day. Mail a check or money order (no cash) to Peoples, PO Box 644760, Pittsburgh, PA 15264-4760; former Peoples TWP customers use PO Box 747105, Pittsburgh, PA 15274-7105. Pay in person at a CheckFreePay location.

help.title: Direct Debit
paragraphs: Direct Debit drafts your bill from a checking or savings account on a day you choose, 11 to 21 days after the bill date. For example, choosing 12 means the draft happens on or after the 12th calendar day after your bill date.

To enroll, log in to Peoples e-Account, open Payment Method in the Payment section, select the Bank Accounts tab, click Add Bank Account and choose Direct Debit. Update your stored bank information there if you change banks.

help.title: Scheduling a payment
paragraphs: Bank account payments can be dated up to 30 days ahead. Choose Pay Bill, then Pay Now, enter the amount and payment method, click Next, pick a date in the Payment Schedule calendar and click Submit. Pending payments show under Billing, then History.

help.title: Help Me Pay
paragraphs: Budget Billing averages your usage for a steady monthly bill. The Customer Assistance Program (CAP) bases payments on income instead of usage; apply by phone or online and send proof of income.

LIHEAP grants are paid directly to Peoples and never need to be repaid, with extra crisis funds in emergencies. The Dollar Energy Fund grant requires applying for LIHEAP first when it is open and a good-faith payment within 90 days. A medical certification can delay a shutoff for up to 30 days.

help.title: Stop service
paragraphs: Stop residential service online through Peoples e-Account or by calling 1-800-764-0111, Monday to Friday, 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. Have your service address with ZIP code, your preferred stop date and your Social Security number ready.
Landlords can enroll in Landlord Automatic Transfer so the account moves into their name when a tenant stops service.

extra.intent: Using the Peoples help pages, find the range of days after the bill date you can choose for Direct Debit. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Between 11 and 21 days after the bill date.
